Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to directly analyze the video content as instructed. Instead of scanning through the video to identify timestamps where multiple bird species are present on camera simultaneously, they repeatedly provided metadata and screenshots of the YouTube interface and comments section. This failure to engage with the actual video content led to the inability to extract the necessary timestamps and screenshots for further analysis, ultimately resulting in the wrong solution.
